title: Data Science & Analytics Intern, Alliances & Channels - February 2027
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
About Futureforce University Recruiting
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.
Job Category
Fixed Term & Temporary
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Start date: 01 February 2027
Duration: 6 months
Location: Paris
Salesforce is the Customer Company, shaping the future of business with AI, Data, and CRM. Guided by our core values, we help organizations across all industries innovate and build stronger customer relationships. We empower you to be a Trailblazer—driving growth, exploring new ideas, and making a positive impact.
Join us as a Data Science Analytics Intern to support our Alliance and Channel team. At Salesforce, you will work with the latest innovations, including Agentforce AI.
Key Responsibilities:
The intern will focus on improving and automating systems and processes, with a strong emphasis on leveraging Artificial Intelligence techniques. Responsibilities include analysing data, creating dashboards, identifying process optimisation opportunities, and implementing automation solutions using AI-driven approaches. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, experience with data analysis tools familiarity with AI/ML frameworks, and an interest in process improvement. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are required. This internship offers exposure to cross-functional collaboration and real-world business impact.
Profile:
Current student pursuing a Master’s degree (graduating in 2027 or 2028).
Background in computer science, engineering, analytics or programming.
Passionate about technology’s impact.
Creative problem-solver, curious, and self-driven.
Adaptable and eager to learn.
Fluent in English and French.

Salesforce est « The Customer Company », façonnant l’avenir des entreprises grâce à l’IA, aux données et au CRM. Guidés par nos valeurs fondamentales, nous aidons les organisations de tous secteurs à innover et à renforcer leurs relations clients. Nous vous donnons les moyens de devenir un Trailblazer : stimuler la croissance, explorer de nouvelles idées et avoir un impact positif.
Rejoignez-nous en tant que Stagiaire Data Science Analytics pour soutenir notre équipe Alliance et Channel. Chez Salesforce, vous travaillerez avec les dernières innovations, y compris Agentforce AI.
Responsabilités principales :
Le stagiaire se concentrera sur l’amélioration et l’automatisation des systèmes et processus, en mettant fortement l’accent sur l’exploitation de techniques d’intelligence artificielle. Les missions incluent l’analyse de données, la création de tableaux de bord, l’identification d’opportunités d’optimisation des processus, et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’automatisation basées sur l’IA. Le candidat idéal possède de solides compétences analytiques, une expérience avec des outils d’analyse de données, une familiarité avec les frameworks IA/ML, et un intérêt pour l’amélioration des processus. Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d’équipe requises. Ce stage offre une exposition à la collaboration transversale et un impact concret sur l’entreprise.
Profil :
Étudiant(e) en cours de Master (diplômé en 2027 ou 2028).
Formation en informatique, ingénierie, analytique ou programmation.
Passionné(e) par l’impact de la technologie.
Esprit créatif, curieux et autonome.
Adaptable et désireux(se) d’apprendre.
Maîtrise de l’anglais et du français.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
